=== Fold writes the marker when the file remembers folds
--- given markers=on
- a‸
  - b
--- when command fold
--- then consumed
- a‸ %% fold %% ⊟
  - b

=== Unfold removes the marker when the file remembers folds
--- given markers=on
- a‸ %% fold %% ⊟
  - b
--- when command unfold
--- then consumed
- a‸
  - b

=== Fold writes no marker when the setting is off
--- given
- a‸
  - b
--- when command fold
--- then consumed
- a‸ ⊟
  - b

=== Unfold leaves an existing marker alone when the setting is off
--- given
- a‸ %% fold %% ⊟
  - b
--- when command unfold
--- then consumed
- a‸ %% fold %%
  - b

=== Tab into a folded sibling strips its marker with the unfold
--- given markers=on
- a %% fold %% ⊟
  - a1
- b‸
--- when key Tab
--- then
- a
  - a1
  - b‸

=== Collapse all writes a marker on every level in one edit
--- given markers=on
- a‸
  - b
    - c
--- when command collapse-all
--- then consumed
- a‸ %% fold %% ⊟
  - b %% fold %% ⊟
    - c

=== Expand all removes every marker in one edit
--- given markers=on
- a‸ %% fold %% ⊟
  - b %% fold %% ⊟
    - c
--- when command expand-all
--- then consumed
- a‸
  - b
    - c

=== A moved folded item keeps its marker and its fold
--- given markers=on
- a
- b‸ %% fold %% ⊟
  - b1
--- when command move-up
--- then
- b‸ %% fold %% ⊟
  - b1
- a

=== Duplicate copies the marker with the fold
--- given markers=on
- a‸ %% fold %% ⊟
  - b
--- when command duplicate
--- then
- a %% fold %% ⊟
  - b
- ‸a %% fold %% ⊟
  - b

=== An item folded without a marker gets one on the next edit in the list
--- given markers=on
- a ⊟
  - a1
- b‸
- c
--- when command move-down
--- then
- a %% fold %% ⊟
  - a1
- c
- b‸

=== Fold on an item without children writes nothing
--- given markers=on
- a‸
- b
--- when command fold
--- then consumed
- a‸
- b

=== Move to a folded target in another list strips the target's marker
--- given markers=on
- a‸

text

- x %% fold %% ⊟
  - x1
--- when move-to 4
--- then
⏎

text

- x
  - x1
  - ‸a

=== Fold puts the marker before a trailing block id
--- given markers=on
- ‸item ^abc
  - child
--- when command fold
--- then consumed
- ‸item %% fold %% ^abc ⊟
  - child

=== Unfold removes a marker that sits before a block id
--- given markers=on
- ‸item %% fold %% ^abc ⊟
  - child
--- when command unfold
--- then consumed
- ‸item ^abc
  - child

=== Fold on a task item with a block id keeps the id last
--- given markers=on
- [ ] ‸item ^abc
  - child
--- when command fold
--- then consumed
- [ ] ‸item %% fold %% ^abc ⊟
  - child

=== Unfold on a task item with a block id removes the marker only
--- given markers=on
- [ ] ‸item %% fold %% ^abc ⊟
  - child
--- when command unfold
--- then consumed
- [ ] ‸item ^abc
  - child

=== An item with a block id folded without a marker gets one before the id on the next edit
--- given markers=on
- a ^a1 ⊟
  - a1
- b‸
- c
--- when command move-down
--- then
- a %% fold %% ^a1 ⊟
  - a1
- c
- b‸

=== Unfold strips a marker written after the block id by an earlier build
--- given markers=on
- ‸item ^abc %% fold %% ⊟
  - child
--- when command unfold
--- then consumed
- ‸item ^abc
  - child
